card: Enables the basic block filter index in the process_message and process_messages fuzz harnesses, allowing P2P fuzz targets to process BIP 157 messages. It also destroys block filter indexes in ChainTestingSetup teardown to prevent use-after-free issues against destroyed validation signals. Previously, BIP 157 message handlers were completely unexercised by fuzzing. The author demonstrates that running the target with a sample input immediately triggers an integer overflow UBSan error in net_processing.cpp.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; patch rebased with identical functionality.
evidence: PR description: 'The BIP157 P2P messages are not covered by any fuzz targets at all.'

PR description demonstrates that a sample getcfcheckpt input immediately triggers an unsigned integer overflow UBSan runtime error in net_processing.cpp (reported in PR #36321) once the filter index is enabled.
problem: BIP 157 compact block filter P2P messages (such as getcfilters, getcfheaders, and getcfcheckpt) are ignored during P2P message fuzzing because the fuzz targets never initialize a block filter index. Additionally, initializing block filter indexes in test setups without destroying them before validation signals are destroyed causes a use-after-free bug during index shutdown.

risk.why: Touches only fuzz harnesses and test setup helpers; a mistake could cause test crashes or deadlocks during fuzzing without affecting production code.

scope_notes: All changes are confined to test utilities and fuzz targets.
summary: Initializes the basic block filter index within the process_message and process_messages fuzz targets, allowing fuzz harnesses to exercise BIP 157 P2P message processing. It adds an option to ResetChainmanAndMempool to initialize, sync, and stop the basic filter index against the static testing chain. It also ensures all block filter indexes are destroyed during ChainTestingSetup teardown and chainman resets to prevent use-after-free bugs.
